(ta)༄༅/rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gang la brten pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅/ rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs// ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig gang la brten pa yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel ba'i tshul// dge 'dun sde la rag las pas// de yi dbye ba brtsam par bya// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ rgya dang bod do// rgya la bzhi ste/ phal chen pa dang*/ thams cad yod par smra ba dang*/ gnas brten pa dang*/ mang pos bkur ba'o// phal chen gyi sde la lnga ste/ shar gyi ri bo'i sde dang*/ nub kyi ri bo'i sde dang*/ gangs rir gnas pa'i sde dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde dang*/ btags par smra ba'i sde'o// de la yang kha cig bzang po lam pa yang zer ro// thams cad yod par smra ba la bdun te/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde dang*/ 'od srung ba'i sde dang*/ sa ston pa'i sde dang*/ chos srung pa'i sde dang*/ mang du thos pa'i sde dang*/ gos dmar can gyi sde dang*/ rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde'o// yang kha cig na mang du thos pa la yul 'khor bzang po yang zer ro// rnam par phye ste smra ba la rgyal sras lam pa yang zer ro// gnas brtan pa'i sde la gsum ste/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i sde dang*/ 'jigs byed ri la gnas pa'i sde dang*/ gtsug lag khang chen la gnas pa'i sde'o// mang pos bkur ba la gsum ste/ sa sgrogs rigs kyi sde dang*/ rjes su srung ba'i sde dang*/ gnas ma bu'i sde ste bco brgyad do// de ltar sde pa tha dad par klog pa'i 'khor lo nas/ yul don slob dpon gyi bye brag gis tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad gyes/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad du// gyur te 'gro ba'i bla ma de// sngon gyi phrin las dbang gis yin// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad kyang gnyis su 'dus te/ mdo sde pa dang*/ bre brag tu smra ba'o// phal chen pa ni dang po yin la/

de las gzhan pa ni phyi ma yin no// zhes mkhas pa chen po gsung ngo*// gnyis pa bod kyi sde pa rnams ni/ thams cad yod smra'i sde pa rnams kyi mkhan po'i bye brag gis sde rigs so sor bstan to// dbus kyi sde bzhi la klu mes dang*/ sba dang*/ rag sha dang*/ 'bring tsho'o// klu mes la sde bzhi/ rgyal lha khang nas mched pa zhang skor dang*/ rgyal sar khang nas mched pa klan skor dang*/ yer ba ba ring nas mched pa sdog skor dang*/ sol nag thang po che nas mched pa klu med kyi skor ro// sba la gnyis su byung ste/ yung nga gur nas gyes pa'i sba gcen gyi rgyud/ lan pa rta bres nas gyes pa'i rgyud sba gcung gi rgyud do// rag tsho la gnyis te/ lan pa spyil bu nas gyes pa'i rag sha gcen gyi rgyud dang*/ go ro mtshar rna nas gyes pa'i rag sha gcung gi rgyud do// lhas kyi klu mgon nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho stod pa dang*/ skar chung lha khang nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho bar pa dang*/ snye thang brag sna nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho smad pa'o// smad tsho ni sba rag gi bye brag yin pas rma shākya byang chub kyis sba dang rag sha la sdom pa blangs nas 'phan yul 'jog po'i klu gong bzung*/ de la dar byang chub gsal bas sdom pa blangs nas rdol po 'on 'chang rdo rje bzung*/ rma shākya byang chub la/ zhang shākya seng ges sdom pa blangs nas phod mod lha khang bzung*/ de tsho las mched pa la smad tsho zer ro// ra sgreng dang*/ 'or dang*/ gsang phu gsum jo bo'i gnas gsum zer nas smad kyi sde rigs bzhi po gang du'ang mi gtogs mod kyi/ da lta ni ra sgreng sba rag sgrel/ 'or rma tsho dang 'brel gsang phu 'bring tsho dang 'brel lo// gtsang gi sde gnyis la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi skor la/ stod smad bar gsum byung*/ lo tsho stod pa la gsum ste/ stag la byang chub kyi stag tsho dang*/ rgya shākya'i bande'i skor gyi rgya tsho dang*/

skyo shes rab rdo rje'i skor gyi skyo dang*/ de gsum bsdams na rgya tsho stag tsho skyo tsho gsum ste/ stod kyi khral tsho gsum yin/ a me zhu gcig ma'i skor dang*/ li blo gros gzhon nu'i skor dang*/ 'dar rdo rje rin chen gyi skor la/ 'dar tsho gsum zhes zer te/ de dag la zhang tsho li tsho 'dar tsho gsum zer ro// lo tsho smad pa la khral tsho phyed dang drug yod de/ kyi zhal gnyis/ brlag tsho glang tsho gnyis/ na ga rgyan gong*/ rgyan gong ba mo skor ro// de la na ga rgyan skor gsum khral tsho phyed du byed de/ de'i skor la/ pan gyi bya tsha dang*/ pa tshab kyi ma jo phug lha khang dang*/ mgur mo lha khang dang*/ sna bzhi lha khang rnams yin mod kyis/ zhwa lu'i gseb tu song nas med do// rgyan tsho wa mo skor la nyid kyis 'ong kha/ sna ris gong ma/ shab kyi 'dar sgang dang*/ srad kyi ltang ldang de tsho las mched pa ni/ wa mo skor zhes bya ba yin/ ma ral thad nas mched pa ni rgya tsho yin/ dbye'i lha khang nas mched pa skyo tsho yin/ skad des lho brag tu byon nas mkhan po byas pa la rtswa tsho zhes byas te/ gnyal lho brag g.yo ru stong pa gsum la sde pa gnam gyi skar ma tsam zhig yod de/ stag lo lha khang nas gyes pa la stag tsho zer/ 'phrang brag dmar las gyes pa tsho la zha tsho zer/ lha khang rma ru nas gyes pa la zhu tsho zer/ 'ol tshal grags pa de de nas mched pa yin/ shab kyi na rang sgo mtsho nas gyes pa tsho la 'dar tsho zer/ kyi tsho la stod smad bar dang gsum ste/ stod pa la khral tsho bzhi/ grang chung skor dang*/ rgya tsho dang*/ bar tsho'o// rba gtsug chen gyi mkhan po byas nas grang chung nas gyes pa tsho la grang chung skor zer/ rgya shākya bandes mkhan po byas nas nyi rong khong brkyang bzung nas de las mched pa tsho la rgya tsho zer/ kyi ston brtson 'bar gyis mkhan po byas nas dug chung bzung nas de nas mched pa tsho la khri tsho zer/

sa phug 'dzin gyis sa rbad kyis mkhan po byas pa tsho la sar tsho zer/ kyi tsho bar pa la gnyis te/ 'khris bya bskyungs skor/ kyi tsho smad pa la gnyis te/ gye re glang ra nas mched pa la glang ra skor zer/ myug gi gnas sar nas mched pa la ur tsho zer/ lce shes rab rdo rjes mkhan po byas nas zhwa lu nas mched pa la ka bzhi dang gdung drug mgo ral pa can dang bdun bya ba byung ste/ ka bzhi ni gur/ dga' ba gdong gnyis/ g.yus ni ser gnyis te bzhi'o// gdung drug ni kho re lha khang dang*/ re lha khang dang*/ pho 'gal dang*/ 'dol chung gnyis/ zha phu dang rgya thang ngo*// mgo ral pa can ni nyang stod byang chad do// de tsho la zhwa lu skor/ gsum pa klag tsho la gsum ste/ klag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po mdzad nas chu mig bzung ste/ de nas mched pa la chu mig skor zer/ klag gi grogs po 'gar gyis bsnyems pa bzung*/ sdog gis spun gsum bzung ba yin mod kyis/ sde pa tha dad kyi ming ma byung*/ klag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi mkhan bu/ klag shākya ye shes kyi mkhan po byas pa'i rkyang btsun spra mos bzung ba'i gnas skor la/ rkang tsho zer/ klang tsho la stod smad gnyis byung ste/ klang btsun byams pas kri gong bzung nas de nas mched pa la klang tsho stod pa zer/ des g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang bzung nas de las mched pa la smad pa zer/ gnyis pa tshong tsho la gsum ste/ stod smad bar pa'o// stod pa la gnyis/ skal rgyan skor ro// bar pa la gnyis/ gnas rnying pa dang gnas gsar skor ro// tshong btsun gyis shab kyi lha mo lung bzung nas de las mched pa la/ gnas rnying zer ro// lcang ra nas mched pa gnas gsar skor ro// tshong tsho la smad pa lnga'o// tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung nas rtsis lha khang phul ba'i tshe kho rang gi nye gnas lcang btsun la gtad/ des mkhan po mdzad pa tsho la lcang skor zer/ de la gsum byung ste/

rtsis pa skor la lcang tsho smad pa zer/ lce dang bye mda' ba tsho la bar pa zer/ skyegs dang ze thang dang shong khur skor tsho la stod pa zer/ de nas a me tshong btsun yo lcags sha ris nyang tsho phul nas bzung ba'i tshe/ khong gis mkhan po mdzad nas ra blo gros bzang po dang 'khams pa rin chen bzang po dang gnyis rab tu byung bsnyen pa rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de gnyis la nyang tsho gtad/ de gnyis kyis mkhan po byas pa la ra tsho dang*/ khams tsho bya ba byung ste/ ra la phyug tshang dgra bcom gyis ngur smrig phul nas de'i skor la ra tsho zer/ 'khams pa'i mkhan bu khro ba 'bar ba rgyal mtshan gyis tshul chen 'og ma dang*/ yung gis gnas gsar bzung ste/ 'khams pa'i mkhan bu gcig gis rong gi lcang mkhar bzung*/ de tsho 'khams tsho'o// de gnyis la nya tsho skor du grags so// de nas a mo la bya chos mkhar po che phul ba'i tshe/ khong gis mkhan bu rgya rgyal bu tshul les bya chos nas brang thang bskyed do// de'i mkhan bu kau yes 'byung gis dmu bskyed/ de gnyis las mched pa tsho la bya skor/ de a mes mar byon pa'i shul du yon bdag mo gnyos mos smon gro phul/ de'i mkhan bu mar pa ye shes rdo rje la gtad/ des mkhan po mdzad nas rnal po grags pa rgyal mtshan rab tu byung ste/ mkhan phug bzung*/ mar pa'i mkhan bu gcig gis rkyus thang bzung*/ mar pa'i mkhan bu gnyi ba chen po dong phug bzung*/ de nas mched pa la dong nag skor zer/ tshas kha thung brag dmar po bzung*/ de nas mched pa la kha thung skor zer/ cong ros nang gong gi mang ra bzung*/ de nas mched pa la mang ra skor/ tsho btsun gyi mkhan bu zhang pa tshab khrod pas ra sogs mtshar la bzung*/ des mkhan po byas pa'i dge mthong gis rong sa do dang*/ stag tshal mkhar sar dang rgyan mkhar rkyang thur tsho bzung*/ zhang gis khyim ser gyi sgang khrod dang*/ brag gshong dang*/ btsan mo lding dang*/ rtsis kyi yang dben bzung de tsho la de tsho skor zer/

spyir 'khams su bka' drin zhus pa la de tsho dang mnyam por shangs pa sde pa dbu dkar ba dang*/ 'o brgyad spun gnyis kyis kyang phyin pa yin mod kyi sde pas gru mo spangs rtsa brtsigs te/ tshong tsho'i gseb tu song*/ 'o brgyad spun gnyis kyis sde gang yang ma bzung*/ spyir de ltar yin pa la 'bre gnyis kyi byung lugs ni/ 'bro ston gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis rta nag bye tshang bzung nas mkhan bu krog ge chung la brten nas yar stag sde chos lung gi skor tsho mched/ bar shangs kyi bye phug nas shangs kyi 'bre tsho mched do// 'jad du 'bre tsho ba bzhi la nyang btsun smon lam rgyal mtshan gyis stong khrod bzung nas de'i skor tsho mched do// lcang btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis khyel gyi lug lam bzung nas lcang tsho mched do// mi btsun rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'jad kyi mar stong bzung nas mi tsho stod smad du gyes so// gnas brgyad pa'i mkhan po la brten nas de dag gi sde skor gyes so// lam mo bye tshang nas rta nag gi 'bre tsho gyes/ 'o bskol phya'i ston tshang man chad nas dbus kyi rtag phru dgon pa man chad bye tshang nas chad do// wa zhwa ye shes g.yung drung gis 'o thug gi ra sha bzung*/ de nas sna nam 'dre sna bzung*/ phyis stag gis gnas mo che bzung*/ de'i lam stegs su kho ra re khang 'khor bzung*/ de nas ldan gyi gre shod bzung*/ de'i mkhan bu sog ston yon tan tshul khrims kyi bla mas ldan gyi ba so thang bzung*/ kho ra gnyan pa gong dang*/ khu lung lha gral dang nyang smad bud kha bzung*/ 'dre brdas dang 'tshal zhabs dang dpag tshal bzung*/ sog gi mkhan bu yang 'dul ba 'dzin pas stag gi dpe can brtsigs/ sog gi mkhan bu dge bshes zhus klas po che bzung*/ de thams cad la wa tsho zer ba yin/ de rnams ni smad nas yar mched pa'i lugs yin no// stod nas mar dar ba la/ 'dzim pa shes rab 'od kyis 'dzim gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/

de nas mched pa tshol bu tsho smad pa la rgyal gyi thang mar rtsag gi dur lung bzung*/ sa skor gyi deng lag kha/ mdo thang gi 'gyes lung*/ btsan 'khor gyi ri chung*/ rong gi thi lung ste/ gnas drug po mched do// byang chub sems dpa' brag chi lung bzung nas/ yar dmu rdzing bzung*/ mar dgun lhas bzung ste/ de tsho byang chub sems dpa'i skor ro// mon gro 'dul ba 'dzin pas artha shal gyi mon mkhar bzung ba'i pu tsho bar pa'o// pu tsho stod pa la tho ling gser khang*/ rgya zhing gi lha khang*/ kha char gyi lha khang*/ snying po'i gtsug lag khang*/ na mo'i gtsug lag khang*/ nya tsho rigs dang*/ tsha tsha sgang la sogs pa pu tsho stod pa'o// blo ldan gang gis sde pa yi// dbye ba rnam dag shes 'dod na// mkhas pa rnams kyis sbyar ba yi// legs pa'i gtam 'di shes par gyis// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
